executor.bootstrap_limit: A workflow introduced by a pull request is activated only after its trusted bytes land on the default branch. The introducing pull request requires a separately reobserved human Product-Owner COMMENT_WITH_BLOCKER bootstrap record; that record is not an account-level Code Owner approval. A pull_request_review signal is non-authoritative because GitHub evaluates that workflow from the pull-request merge context; the trusted executor consumes no signal output and the periodic default-branch reconciler remains the liveness fallback.
executor.rule: The privileged executor runs only an exact, trusted default-branch workflow SHA. A non-authoritative review signal, every listed PR gate-completion workflow, legacy status events, and a bounded default-branch reconciliation schedule cause it to re-resolve current open PRs through GitHub APIs. A workflow-run source whose event is not its explicitly allowlisted PR event is a safe no-op; a matching source is accepted only after GitHub's run-to-PR association, workflow name, path, event and repository are revalidated. It reobserves base/head/tree/test-merge, diff, comments, reviews, threads, add/remove request history, competing writers and observed Actions check/legacy-status gates immediately. Changed-file count, files-page count, rendered-diff header count and bounded API limits must agree before a scope is exact-bound. It records one deduplicated exact-binding COMMENT_WITH_BLOCKER review when a required requested-review disposition is absent, and fails closed until GitHub records an eligible reviewer substantive disposition. Observed green gates never assert branch-protection, merge, review-ready, release, deployment or external-effect readiness.

issue_lifecycle.execute_now_rule: When clear supported and technically actionable begin or resume the smallest bounded work unit.
issue_lifecycle.clarification_rule: Ask only the minimum bounded question whose answer is required for safe execution and record the missing field or decision.
issue_lifecycle.blocked_rule: A blocker requires a deterministic failure class evidence references retry condition and one next technically possible action.
issue_lifecycle.close_completed_rule: Close only when completion or canonical supersession is evidenced.
issue_lifecycle.close_not_planned_rule: Close with an explicit supported-scope or authorization reason.
issue_lifecycle.close_invalid_rule: Close when the request is not reproducible not traceable internally contradictory untrue or technically unsupported and record the reason.

notification_rule: Notify only on a new or changed disposition blocker resolution head or scope change completed work unit issue closure or promotion readiness.
